slices.python_random: random.Random(seed).shuffle per stratum, strata visited in sorted order, round robin
slices.rule: stratum = (language in TypeScript/Go/Python/Rust/JavaScript/Swift else other, star tier 40k+/10-40k/3-10k)

new-names.rule: A: names in 2+ repos, up to 2 repos each; B: 30 seeded names seen once; C: docs/ folders

small-groups.rule: first 3 files per folder by path order; every matching file; 6 seeded sub-folder READMEs

terms.rule: 30 contexts per word, round robin over document kinds; context text left out

precision.rule: 10 positive files per flag; 7 release bodies per element
